meta.name: peft-fine-tuning
meta.description: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning for LLMs using LoRA, QLoRA, and 25+ methods. Use when fine-tuning large models (7B-70B) with limited GPU memory, when you need to train <1% of parameters with minimal accuracy loss, or for multi-adapter serving. HuggingFace's official library integrated with transformers ecosystem.

copy.tagline: 用 LoRA 等方法微调大语言模型，节省 GPU 内存
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在有限显存下微调 7B-70B 参数的大模型
copy.tagline_en: Fine-tune large language models with LoRA and 25+ methods, saving GPU memory
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to fine-tune 7B-70B models with limited GPU memory

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以指导你使用 LoRA、QLoRA 等方法对大型语言模型进行参数高效微调，仅训练不到 1% 的参数，从而在消费级 GPU 上微调 7B-70B 模型。
howto.when: 当你需要微调大型模型（7B-70B）但 GPU 内存有限，或者希望训练少于 1% 的参数且精度损失最小，或者需要多适配器服务时触发。

say.text: 如何在单张 24GB GPU 上微调 70B 模型？
say.note: Claude 会推荐 QLoRA 方法并给出配置。

say.text: 加载已训练的 LoRA 适配器并合并到基础模型。
say.note: Claude 会提供加载和合并适配器的代码。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can guide you through parameter-efficient fine-tuning of large language models using LoRA, QLoRA, and 25+ methods, training less than 1% of parameters to fine-tune 7B-70B models on consumer GPUs.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to fine-tune large models (7B-70B) with limited GPU memory, train <1% of parameters with minimal accuracy loss, or serve multiple adapters.

say_en.text: Help me fine-tune Llama 3.1 8B with LoRA using the Dolly dataset.
say_en.note: Claude will generate LoRA fine-tuning code.

say_en.text: How to fine-tune a 70B model on a single 24GB GPU?
say_en.note: Claude will recommend QLoRA and provide configuration.

say_en.text: Load a trained LoRA adapter and merge it into the base model.
say_en.note: Claude will provide code for loading and merging adapters.
